P.name: Strategy
items: Your processes are written down clearly enough that an AI agent could run them.

P.name: Attract
items: Your content gets drafted in your voice by an agent, and you approve it instead of writing it.

P.name: Convert
items: Every lead from your site, forms and free tools lands in your CRM and gets followed up on its own.

P.name: Close
items: Every DM and form lead gets a reply within minutes, day or night, and calls get booked without you.

P.name: Deliver
items: Buyers get what they paid for within minutes, without you touching it.

P.name: Support
items: Common questions get answered by an agent trained on your own docs, around the clock.

P.name: Signal
items: You can tell which ad brought in each sale, and your ad platform counts the same sales your CRM does.

BANDS: You are the system. Every sale and every delivery runs through you.
Lots of apps, few agents. The tools still need you to run them.
Agents do real work in parts of the business. The gaps still cost you.
Agents run the work and people check it. Now it's about scale.
